general.name: GOSI (Social Insurance) — Saudi nationals
general.description: General Organization for Social Insurance: pension (annuities), occupational hazards and SANED unemployment insurance for Saudi national employees.

eligibility.notes: Saudi (and GCC) nationals. Rates shown are the post-July-2026 step of the new regime (members registered on/after 3 Jul 2024): employee 10.75% (pension 10% + SANED 0.75%), employer 12.75% (pension 10% + occupational hazards 2% + SANED 0.75%). Members on the pre-2024 regime remain at employee 9.75% / employer 11.75%.

calculationRules.name: Contributory wage
calculationRules.description: Contributions are on basic wage plus the housing allowance, floored at SAR 1,500 and capped at SAR 45,000 per month.

reporting.dueDate: By the 15th of the following month

validations.name: Nationals only
validations.errorMessage: The full GOSI scheme applies only to Saudi and GCC nationals; expatriates carry occupational-hazards cover only
